observations.view: All main, cab, outlier and exact comparisons were inspected. Board raster cells are unscaled 160 by 160 pixels.
observations.main: Smooth sky and coherent coarse fence in all displayed policies. Fine building wires and leaves remain soft.
observations.cab: Both ROIs and noise profiles inspected with both JPEGs and the independent AHD capture. Transferred right diagonals and incomplete intersections persist. Changes in background modulation are slight.
observations.outliers: Batch-two lit sign is visually stable. Largest geometry deltas lie on a tiny point light behind dark bars and the fringe of saturated signage. Overall light shapes remain similar.
observations.exact: The four exact boards cover short and long canvases. Large tiles preserve window bars and soften fine masonry. The long clipped cycling photo changes yellow-green fill and clipped transitions at the faster geometry.
observations.TensorRT fixed photo: Both score tails were replayed and viewed at native scale. Under the default display the near-white background looks similar across paths. The loss case has a measurable camera-green shift.
